results.explanation: At the declared ShareLinkViewSet.create entry, the viewset uses IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions, and its POST mapping is the add_sharelink permission for the share-link model. PassUserMixin supplies request.user to serializers derived from SerializerWithPerms. During share-link creation, ShareLinkSerializer.validate_document requires both global documents.view_document and has_perms_owner_aware(user, "view_document", document). The premises satisfy the global permission but deny the owner-aware object check because the document belongs to another user and the caller has no object grant. The serializer therefore raises PermissionDenied before the share-link object is created. Thus authorization to create the share-link object is distinct from authorization to view its target document: global add_sharelink covers the former, while the target-document validation requires the latter. Global view_document does not substitute for the owner-aware check; it is only one conjunct of the validation condition. The supplied source does not show a successful create path beyond this denial, and no decisive runtime fact is missing under the stated premises.

entry.statement: ShareLinkViewSet is the create-capable viewset for ShareLink and declares its permission classes.

citations.quote:
class ShareLinkViewSet(
    PassUserMixin,
    CreateModelMixin,
    RetrieveModelMixin,
    DestroyModelMixin,
    ListModelMixin,
    GenericViewSet,
):
    model = ShareLink

    queryset = ShareLink.objects.select_related("document")

    serializer_class = ShareLinkSerializer
    pagination_class = StandardPagination
    permission_classes = (IsAuthenticated, PaperlessObjectPermissions)

binding.statement: PassUserMixin passes request.user into serializers that are SerializerWithPerms subclasses.
Share-link serializer validation receives the referenced document and applies a dedicated validate_document check.

control.statement: Target-document validation requires both global documents.view_document and the owner-aware has_perms_owner_aware view_document check.
PaperlessObjectPermissions maps POST to the model add permission, so the share-link object creation permission is add_sharelink.

effect.statement: Failure of the target-document validation raises PermissionDenied, so the share-link object is not created.

condition.statement: The owner-aware single-object check allows the owner or an object permission recognized by ObjectPermissionChecker; for a document owned by another user without an object grant, that check is false under the premises.

citations.quote:
def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)
